title: Articles, Modals & Work Situations
subtitle: Practice with articles, modal verbs and work vocabulary.
lessonNotes: Use profession vocabulary and shorter listening practice.

grammar.title: Articles in context
grammar.rule: Use a/an for one non-specific item, the for a specific item, and no article for general plural nouns.

grammar.title: Modal verbs
grammar.rule: Use can for ability, should for advice and could for a polite suggestion.

vocabulary.meaning: a person who manages staff matters
a person who cuts or arranges hair
a person who designs how an app feels to use

practice.q: At a clinic, she is ___ pediatrician.
practice.explanation: Use a because pediatrician starts with a consonant sound.

practice.q: A colleague needs help. You say: ‘You ___ email the HR manager.’
practice.explanation: Use can + base verb for a possible action.

reading.title: A New Role at the Clinic
reading.text: A new employee meets clinic professionals and works with a UX designer to improve an appointment page.

listening.title: Four conversations
listening.instructions: Listen to Conversation A about a work interview. First find the main outcome, then listen for job details and next steps.
listening.script: Use the linked audio and exercises before answering the listening questions.

questions.q: During a second listen, a learner notes job details and next steps. Is this useful?

writing: Write advice to a friend preparing for a new job. Use can, should and could.
Write about one profession and use articles in context.

quiz.q: At a clinic, she is ___ pediatrician.
Peter’s ___ is to organise the team.
At the clinic, the ___ helps children.

opt: Could you to check the connection?

quiz.q: The gym near my home is:

opt: We could to add a clearer page.
We could add a clearer page.
We could adding a clearer page.
We could adds a clearer page.
quiz.a: We could add a clearer page.
